relations.subject: LACROIX, Alphonse François
relations.evidence: Accepted as agent of the Netherlands Missionary Society at Chinsura (then in Dutch possession), he arrived there in 1821.

relations.subject: LACROIX, Alphonse François
relations.evidence: When Chinsura became British in 1825 he became British subject and member of London Missionary Society.

relations.subject: LACROIX, Alphonse François
relations.evidence: Married 1825 Hannah Herklots, several children (a daughter married —> J. Mullens).
